name: vibe-prompt
description: Audit, organize, classify, grade, remediate, and evolve the LLM prompts shipped in your app. Static inventory + 12-smell audit (F1-F12) + behavioral drift testing with 5-dimension scoring + monotonic baseline regression tracking + confidence-routed remediation + creative discovery of new prompts. /vibe-prompt:scan inventories every prompt site (handlebars + template-literal + concat + JSX-attr) and classifies templated vars by origin (user-controlled vs system-injected); /vibe-prompt:audit fires structural findings with per-prompt scores (schema tightness, persona consistency, instruction clarity, token efficiency, injection resistance) — F9 checks date-grounding, F10-F12 grade prompt-injection vulnerability against user-controlled vars only with cross-plugin handoff hints to vibe-sec; /vibe-prompt:eval runs prompts against the prod model and an in-session Claude baseline with SWRS + Long CoT + Swap-and-Discard calibration, value-type-drift mechanical check, and optional --inject-attacks mode (6 canonical injection patterns, binary judge, cost-gated); /vibe-prompt:grade synthesizes audit + eval scores into per-prompt + app composite grades across 5 dimensions and tracks regression vs monotonic baseline; /vibe-prompt:remediate closes the audit→fix loop with three confidence-routed fix categories (A composer-level additions, B contradiction removal, C defense addition), backup batches + atomic rollback, and F12 handoff to vibe-sec; /vibe-prompt:iterate discovers new prompts your app could add via creative-divergent LLM call (~$0.02) with handoff hints to /vibe-cartographer:scope or /vibe-iterate:feature-add; /vibe-prompt:radar tracks what's new in the model space for your vendors. TS/JS + Python coverage. Env-var-only key handling; composes with vibe-sec. Validated on Celestia3 (Next.js + Firebase + Gemini).
